name: get_issue_status
description: Get the status, assigned team and last update of one help desk issue by its identifier. Requires a verified caller. Only the caller's own issues are returned.

request_body_schema.description: Tool request body. conversation_id and caller_id are filled by the system, never by the model.

issue_id.description: The issue identifier as the caller said it, digits or words (for example '4127' or 'forty-one twenty-seven'). The service normalises it.
